The official PMR V8 Power Pack release names the Historic USV8 entry as a 1971 AMC Javelin. An archived 1971 AMC brochure independently identifies the Javelin model and its optional four-speed manual equipment.

claims.basis: The official PMR V8 Power Pack release names the Historic USV8 entry as a 1971 AMC Javelin. An archived 1971 AMC brochure independently identifies the Javelin model and its optional four-speed manual equipment.

The period Javelin source documents a four-speed manual option. Applicability to the exact Trans-Am race build is retained as a review note. The documented four-speed manual floor-shift configuration supports an H-pattern baseline, but the exact race-car gate was not photographed. The period manual configuration is a conventional four-speed floor-shift layout; no exact race-car gate image was available to test for a dogleg. A driver-selected H-pattern manual requires a clutch to pull away from rest under the project derivation rule.
